title: Certificate copy run
statement: Let $x$, $p$, and $u$ be binary words with $x=p\mathbin{+\!\!+}u$. Starting in the certificate-copy state with $|p|$ input bits consumed, empty work tape, work head at $0$, and empty output, after every $j\le |u|$ steps the verifier is still in the certificate-copy state, has consumed $|p|+j$ input bits, holds the prefix of $u$ of length $j$ on its work tape, and has its work head at $j$.
replaced:
Let the input be $x = p \mathbin{+\!\!+} u$. Started in the certificate-copy state with
$|p|$ input bits consumed, empty work tape, work head $0$, and empty output, for every
$j \le |u|$ the non-tautology verifier after exactly $j$ steps is still in the copy
state with $|p| + j$ bits consumed, the first $j$ bits of $u$ on the work tape, the
work head at cell $j$, and empty output.
